detectors.name: test_tampering
detectors.query: test[error] ..[not (test and not error)]> edit[file~"(^|/)(tests?|spec|__tests__)/|(^|/)test_[^/]*$|_test\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$|\.(test|spec)\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$"] ..> test[not error]
detectors.summary: A test run fails, the agent edits a test file before any test passes, and a later test run passes.
detectors.title: Edited the tests to make them pass

detectors.name: hallucinated_tool
detectors.summary: A tool step whose name is not in its requesting model call's tool catalog, or a model call asking for a tool outside its own catalog (only where the catalog was recorded).
detectors.title: Called a tool that was not offered

detectors.name: give_up_loop
detectors.query: tool(@t)[error, fingerprint=@c] (..[not (name=@t and not error)]> tool[error, fingerprint=@c]){2,} ..[not (name=@t and not error)]> llm$
detectors.summary: The same tool call — same tool, same input (its fingerprint) — fails at least 3 times, that tool never succeeds in between or afterwards, and the run ends on a model answer.
detectors.title: Failed the same tool call three times, then gave up

detectors.name: edit_thrash
detectors.summary: The same file is edited at least 5 times within 10 steps.
detectors.title: Edited one file over and over

detectors.name: ping_pong
detectors.summary: Agent A hands to agent B and back to A at least 3 times, with no other agent invoked in between.
detectors.title: Agents handing work back and forth

detectors.name: context_blowup
detectors.summary: A model call's context (at least 1000 tokens) is at least doubled by a model call no more than 5 steps later.
detectors.title: Context doubled within a few steps

detectors.name: retry_without_change
detectors.summary: A step fails and the identical request (same input digest) is sent again, with nothing but model calls in between.
detectors.title: Retried a failed call unchanged

detectors.name: tool_error_streak
detectors.summary: At least 5 tool calls fail with only model calls between them.
detectors.title: Five failing tool calls in a row

detectors.name: unverified_finish
detectors.summary: The run's last edit is followed by no test run before the run ends on a model answer.
detectors.title: Finished without testing the last edit
